doc: THE single normaliser spec shared by the Zeebe capture harness (formal/traces/capture, Java) and the nano differential runner (engine-core/tests/zeebe_traces.rs, Rust). Both sides first produce RAW records shaped like Zeebe's record JSON ({recordType, valueType, intent, rejectionType, value:{...}}) and then apply exactly this spec: (1) a COMMAND_REJECTION record becomes {recordType, valueType, intent, rejectionType} in the trailing rejection lane; (2) an EVENT record whose valueType has a lane and whose intent is listed becomes {valueType, intent, <fields from value, absent -> null>}; (3) everything else (commands, unlisted value types/intents) is dropped; (4) the step's records are the lanes concatenated in the order below, each lane keeping its relative order (interleaving ACROSS lanes is not compared). See formal/traces/README.md.
